candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Overview
verified_facts: OS Terrain 50 is a lower-resolution DTM designed for landscape visualisation and analysis over large areas.
Grid data is verified to 4m RMSE.
semantic_limits: A 4m product RMSE does not make an unweighted all-touched cell median parcel-representative for sub-pixel parcels.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Grid data
verified_facts: Each height value is calculated at the centre of a 50m by 50m pixel.
Rows contain 200 values and progress west-to-east, then 50m south.
semantic_limits: Pixel-centre semantics do not assign equal parcel relevance to all cells merely touching a polygon.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Data structure
verified_facts: Terrain 50 grid heights are raster values calculated at pixel centres.
Tiles do not share common edge values.
semantic_limits: This defines representation, not a parcel aggregation statistic.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 Product supply
verified_facts: Terrain 50 is supplied annually each July.
ASCII/GML supply uses 10km tiles arranged under 100km grid-square folders.
A full national grid supply is about 157MB compressed.
semantic_limits: Supply documentation does not prove current TQ bytes were downloaded in this runtime.

candidates.name: OS Terrain 50 current OpenData product
verified_facts: ASCII Grid and GML (Grid) is a listed format.
Coverage is all of Great Britain.
semantic_limits: Current product metadata is not current parcel-cell elevation evidence.
